skill.name: discord-bot-architect
skill.description: Build production-ready Discord bots with Discord.js and Pycord patterns for commands, interactions, intents, rate limits, and sharding.
skill.summary: Guide Discord bot architecture with slash commands, interactions, scaling patterns, and operational safety practices.
skill.author: sickn33

security_audit.summary: All static findings are in SKILL.md documentation examples, not executable marketplace code. I found no prompt injection or evidence of data exfiltration. Token and .env references are presented as standard Discord bot configuration and safety guidance.

content.value_statement: Discord bot projects often fail around intents, interactions, sharding, and token handling. This skill provides Discord.js and Pycord patterns for reliable bots.
actual_capabilities: Creates Discord.js v14 and Pycord bot foundations with slash commands.
Explains gateway intents, privileged intents, and safer alternatives.
Designs buttons, select menus, modals, and embed responses.
Shows deferred response patterns for slow commands and LLM calls.
Provides rate limit queues and sharding patterns for larger bots.
Documents common failures such as exposed tokens and missing scopes.
limitations: It provides implementation guidance, not a hosted Discord bot service.
Users must provide their own Discord application, tokens, and permissions.
Generated code still needs local testing against current Discord APIs.
It does not replace a security review for high-risk moderation bots.

use_cases.title: Start a JavaScript Bot
use_cases.description: Create a Discord.js v14 project with command folders, event handlers, and a deploy script.

use_cases.title: Build a Python Bot
use_cases.description: Use Pycord patterns for slash commands, cogs, embeds, and interaction responses.

use_cases.title: Scale an Existing Bot
use_cases.description: Plan rate limit handling, sharding, deferred responses, and safer token management.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Starter Bot
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a basic Discord bot using Discord.js v14 with one slash command, minimal intents, and a separate command deployment script.

prompt_templates.title: Add Interactive Components
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a Discord command that uses buttons, a select menu, and a modal. Include error handling and interaction timeouts.

prompt_templates.title: Fix Production Failures
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this Discord bot behavior and explain likely causes for missing slash commands, interaction timeouts, and invalid token errors.

prompt_templates.title: Plan Large Bot Architecture
prompt_templates.prompt: Architect a Discord bot for more than 2500 guilds with sharding, rate limit handling, command deployment workflow, and token safety.

output_examples.input: I need a Discord.js bot with slash commands and buttons.
output_examples.output: A project plan with command folders, event handlers, component flow, required intents, and deployment steps.

output_examples.input: My slash command says the application did not respond.
output_examples.output: A diagnosis covering the three-second response rule, when to defer replies, and how to send follow-up messages.

output_examples.input: My bot is close to the Discord sharding threshold.
output_examples.output: A scaling checklist for shard count, process layout, gateway limits, and cross-shard data access.

best_practices: Use slash commands and components instead of message content parsing when possible.
Defer long-running interactions before database, API, file, or LLM work.
Store bot tokens in environment variables and keep environment files out of Git.
anti_patterns: Do not sync global slash commands on every bot startup.
Do not request privileged intents unless the bot clearly needs them.
Do not block the event loop with synchronous file work in production paths.

faq.question: Does this skill support both JavaScript and Python?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes patterns for Discord.js v14 and Pycord.

faq.question: Can it create slash commands?
faq.answer: Yes. It covers command definitions, deployment scripts, options, and testing workflows.

faq.question: Does it explain Discord privileged intents?
faq.answer: Yes. It explains when intents are needed and recommends avoiding message content intent when possible.

faq.question: Can it help with interaction timeouts?
faq.answer: Yes. It explains immediate acknowledgments, deferred replies, and follow-up responses.

faq.question: Does it handle bot scaling?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes rate limit handling and sharding guidance for larger bots.

faq.question: Will it deploy my bot automatically?
faq.answer: No. It provides architecture and code guidance. You still configure hosting, secrets, and Discord application settings.
